# ProjectKaro

> ProjectKaro is a professional web development and student project studio based in India. We build business websites, full-stack applications, portfolio sites, startup MVPs, and complete academic projects with fixed pricing and on-time delivery.

## Core Services

- Website Development
- Personal Portfolio Websites
- Full Stack Applications
- AI Solutions
- Student Major Projects
- Student Minor Projects
- Research Projects
- Startup MVP Development
- Business Websites
- Technical Consulting

## Key Facts

- 60+ college projects delivered
- 300+ clients served
- 10 services offered
- 24-hour response guarantee
- Fixed pricing with no hidden costs
- Full documentation included with every project
- Viva preparation support for student projects
